name: Flat-top Gaussian Feature Density
definition: A differentiable approximation of feature density using a class of Gaussian functions called flat-top Gaussians, which become more box-like as the parameter p increases.
summary: Flat-top Gaussian Feature Density is a differentiable approximation of feature density that uses a high-degree exponent to create a box-like profile, replacing non-differentiable box functions in adaptive grid-based scene representations.
